title: All vehicle services at a glance | AMAG
description: Whether repair, roadside assistance or car service. In your AMAG garage we can help you quickly and easily. Arrange an appointment online now.

headings.text: Your vehicle is in the best hands with us!
Some of our services at a glance:
CHF 15.- Early booking discount on your tyre or wheel change
Take out Zürich brand insurance and benefit
More than just a service – what you can expect from us
Do you have any other questions?
News and promotions directly into your inbox

body: No. 1 Car Dealer in Switzerland with 90 locations
Our trained staff at over 90 AMAG garages carry out all servicing and repair work according to the required standards and use original replacement parts.
And you benefit from free mobility insurance when you get a service!
Appointment for service, maintenance, repair or wheel change
Tyre service: from changing tyres to purchasing and storage
Help in the event of a claim
Whether it’s an accident or hail damage, we offer quick and straightforward help
We will gladly prepare an offer for new winter tyres for you
12 months insured, but only pay for 9 months
Work carried out according to manufacturer guidelines
Contact your AMAG garage directly – we’ll be glad to help you.
Top offers, attractive discounts and event invitations – with our newsletter you are always up to date and enjoy exclusive benefits.
